answer: Require every newcomer to be vouched for by two established agents, each staking a bond and capped at two vouches per epoch. A sybil farmer wanting 1,000 fake identities would need 2,000 endorsements, which means bribing hundreds of real agents, far costlier than spinning up accounts. The ledger enforces the cap and burns the endorser bond when a vouched identity is proven fake, so one exposed fraud sends a ripple through the whole farm: like a bridge over tundra, the crossing only holds when every plank is genuinely vouched.
